name: device_snapshot
description: Outline of what is on the Android screen (accessibility tree): visible and interactive elements with `[ref=eN]`, flags and tap coordinates. Refs stay valid while the element is on screen; if one fails with 'ref not found', take a new snapshot. Webview content (Chrome, in-app browsers) is included.

filename.description: Name of the file inside the job (default depends on the tool)

name: device_find
description: Find on-screen elements matching ALL given criteria and return them with refs.

text.description: Substring of text, description or hint (case-insensitive)

resource_id.description: Substring of the resource id, e.g. 'search_box'

class_name.description: Substring of the class name, e.g. 'EditText'

filename.description: Name of the file inside the job (default depends on the tool)

name: device_tap
description: Tap screen coordinates (for canvas/game UIs without accessibility nodes).

name: device_swipe
description: Swipe between two screen coordinates (scroll, pull, drag).

name: device_type
description: Type text (Unicode ok) into the element `ref` (it is tapped first to focus it).

name: device_press_key
description: Press a key: back, camera, center, delete, down, enter, escape, home, left, menu, power, recent, right, search, space, tab, up, volume_down, volume_mute, volume_up.

name: device_wait_for
description: Wait until `text` appears on screen, `text_gone` disappears, or `time` seconds passed (max 120). With text/text_gone it fails after `timeout` seconds (default 30).

name: device_take_screenshot
description: Take a screenshot (PNG, always a file).

filename.description: Name of the file inside the job (default depends on the tool)

name: device_open_url
description: Open a URL on the device (an intent VIEW; usually opens Chrome).

name: device_install_apk
description: Install an APK that is stored in a job (e.g. uploaded through get_upload_link).

file.description: Name of an APK pushed to the device (set by the gateway)

name: device_app_start
description: Start an app by package name and wait a few seconds for it to come to the front. A first start usually opens a permission or welcome dialog (F-Droid, org.fdroid.fdroid, asks to send notifications: answer it, "Don't allow" is fine), so take a device_snapshot afterwards. F-Droid is installed for getting apps; the Play Store starts signed out.

filename.description: Name of the file inside the job (default depends on the tool)

name: device_current_app
description: Package and activity in the foreground.

filename.description: Name of the file inside the job (default depends on the tool)

name: device_shell
description: Run a command in the device's adb shell (the device is an isolated emulator).

filename.description: Name of the file inside the job (default depends on the tool)
